probes.label: leaf
probes.why: On supported hosts, the cleanup rejects a present leaf.

probes.label: state-read
probes.why: On supported hosts, returned vibrating is an eager real ownedWrite accessor. The case-file component read witnesses the positive signal creation without claiming this on the unsupported branch.

probes.label: pattern-tracking
probes.why: A callable pattern executes in tracked split-effect compute. Its case-file ordinary signal write throws only in misuse.

probes.label: start-pattern
probes.why: Arm the case-file pattern only after construction; later start invokes it on the calling stack. A cleanup there has no owner after await; the correct twin restores the captured owner.

probes.label: interval-pattern
probes.why: The armed pattern's later native interval dispatch is ownerless; the correct twin restores owner inside the callback. Both stop after the first interval.
